LibTmux.Query.Pane

Description

Physical pane fields and its required window relationship.

Use these tokens with LibTmux.Query; each describes an owned Pane from LibTmux.Snapshot. All are available in the tmux 3.3a baseline. Text comparisons are exact. Command and path values retain POSIX bytes from the endpoint rather than promising UTF-8 or local path semantics.

id :: Field Pane PaneId Source #

Native pane ID. Equality alone does not establish Server identity.

windowId :: Field Pane WindowId Source #

Native ID of the pane's physical window; use window to navigate it.

index :: Field Pane PaneIndex Source #

Pane index within its window, distinct from a window-link index.

width :: Field Pane Dimension Source #

Positive width in cells. Use dimensionAtLeast for an integer threshold.

height :: Field Pane Dimension Source #

Positive height in cells, independent of window-link context.

active :: Field Pane Bool Source #

Whether this is the active pane of its physical window.

dead :: Field Pane Bool Source #

Whether tmux observed the pane's process as dead.

title :: Field Pane Text Source #

UTF-8 pane title. contains performs exact Text substring matching.

currentCommand :: Field Pane PosixString Source #

Foreground command name as lossless POSIX bytes, not a shell command line.

currentPath :: Field Pane PosixPath Source #

Observed current directory on the tmux endpoint, preserving POSIX bytes.

Resolve the pane's physical window in the supplied snapshot with related.
